verdict.rationale: ADK's Workflow Runtime offers fan-out/fan-in and loop constructs that could be used by developers to build bulk-item processing pipelines, but there is no documented built-in 'bulk operations' feature or example for end users acting across many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation tooling/UI, documented examples of processing many items in one call, and evidence of end-user (not just developer-framework) bulk workflows.
